summary: 2006 IEA Outlook: Let the Good Times Roll? 2006 IEA Outlook: Let the Good Times Roll? July 7, 2006 The International Energy Agency (IEA)'s latest Oil Market Report forecasts worldwide oil demand to reach 84.9 million barrels per day (bpd) over 2006, a 1.5% increase over last year's 83.66 million bpd.

children.title: non-OECD Demand
children.summary: The IEA's oil demand projection is consistent with an outlook recently published by the Oil and Gas Journal. Both call for stronger worldwide demand while anticipating slow US demand.

children.title: Middle East
children.summary: Africa As shown above, the IEA's forecast hinges on high rates of growth in China and the Middle East (including India). The two regions account for more than half of the total demand increase forecasted for full-year 2006.

children.title: What Lies Ahead
children.summary: The outlook for the rest of 2006 is for stronger charter hire rates to predominate. The IEA forecasts 2H2006 to reach 85.51 million bpd, a 2.1% increase over 2H2005 demand of 83.76 million bpd.
